rationale.conceptual: The paper uses a standard reactive MD method (ReaxFF in LAMMPS) but requires implementing a specific CNT geometry, thermostat, stress computation, and metric extraction. It is not a novel algorithm but involves multiple interacting components and non-trivial details (e.g., von Mises stress from per-atom tensor). Comparable to a non-trivial established method that needs careful translation into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has four distinct stages: system building, three simulation runs (which could be parallel or sequential), post-processing (stress averaging, mass loss), and snapshot export. It involves handling MD software, force field files, and trajectory I/O, which is a moderate orchestration challenge. Not as simple as a single script nor as complex as a fragile multi-tool chain.
